Small firms cite labour and operating costs as reasons for scaling back hiring, the UK's statistics body says.

[CNBC] 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.33%, new 19-year high on inflation, spending concerns

[CNBC] Disney-owned ABC files First Amendment lawsuit against FCC

[MarketWatch] Stocks keep shrugging off rising Treasury yields. Here’s the level that could finally trigger a selloff.
